description: Java class implementing native interface for serial port communication in the jSSC library, including native method declarations and library loading logic.

classes.name: SerialNativeInterface
classes.description: Java class providing native method declarations and static initialization for loading platform-specific serial port libraries.

methods.name: getNativeLibraryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the native serial port library.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens a serial port with specified name and options.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures serial port parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and parity.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges input/output buffers of the serial port.

methods.name: setEventsMask
methods.description: Sets event mask for serial port events.

methods.name: waitEvents
methods.description: Waits for serial port events and returns event data.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from the serial port.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes bytes to the serial port.

methods.name: getBuffersBytesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes in input and output buffers.

methods.name: getSerialPortNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of available serial port names.

methods.name: getLinesStatus
methods.description: Gets status of serial port control lines.

methods.name: sendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal for specified duration.
